scope: Bounded real-host 2D projection acceptance; point-center markers are not bodies, collisions, spatial chemistry or science findings.

checks.name: Actual CDP argv retains the protected sandbox process model
Unmodified source physical scenario has real SI centers and matching cube projection
State/readouts/paint/inspector commit before an unchanged delayed real history response
All nonsquare planes map actual SI positions to marker pixels and pointer-selected exact IDs
Exact unknown ID is not-present, not a fabricated death
Actual focused arrow keys navigate exact visible IDs and wrap independently in every plane
Inclusive upper/lower boundaries, zero-width center slices and retained outside-slice selection
Actual arrow keys recover outside-slice selection and retain exact selection in an empty slice
Desktop, short desktop and 390/320px layouts expose controls without geometry overlays
Paused view-only controls preserve API state and single-flight poll cadence at draw30/60
Bounded real paused Steps reach first actual division; parent stays absent and coincident daughters remain individually selectable
Real legacy chamber1 retains schematic inventory without physical controls or coordinates

limits: Chromium/Linux; desktop and 390/320px mobile viewports, not a full accessibility or device audit.
30/60 are display targets; achieved FPS and native background scheduling are not asserted.
Canvas methods observe paint arguments unchanged; geometry expectations use actual API coordinates and observed box edges, never production helpers or internal view.hits.
Public-server counters, long-run motion/statistics and new science claims are outside this local real-host gate.
An absent division parent is retained as an absent selection; absence is not a death assertion.
